annotations.title: Look up a colleague or contact

description: Look up a colleague or contact by name, email, or person_id. A uuid typed as the name is read as person_id. Returns who they are (email, title, department, how you work with them, role card when company context is on), plus your own counts and items that name them. Returns choose when several people match; call again with person_id.
name: get_person
title: Look up a colleague or contact
